Thickness is probably about 1.5 cm. The volume is therefore about 8 × 4.5 × 1.5 ≈ 55 cm³. Bread-like pizza has a density of about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives roughly 35–50 g. I'll use 45 g.

Cheese pizza runs about 2.7 kcal/g, so 45 g comes to about 120 kcal.
